recommendation: Tail remains above the block threshold after a technology-led close at two-week lows; the next reassessment depends on post-close and overnight price discovery.
headline: Nasdaq closes at a two-week low as yields and oil remain elevated
body: The Nasdaq Composite closed 1.10% lower at 26,040.53 as major U.S. indexes fell to two-week lows. The 10-year Treasury yield was near 4.70%, VIX rose above 16 late in the session, and Brent reached about $94.60. Fresh shared Finviz context showed 7 of 8 tracked megacaps and 5 of 7 tracked semiconductor names negative. The sustained late-day decline and aligned cross-asset pressure keep Tail elevated, while incomplete detailed NQ pullback evidence limits further escalation.

outlookSummary: Immediate post-close risk remains elevated because the Nasdaq finished at a two-week low with yields, oil, volatility, and broad megacap weakness aligned. Tail is modeled to ease conditionally through maintenance and overnight trading if price discovery becomes two-sided. Friday's cash open and 16:00 Berlin state labor release form the next concentrated checkpoint.
